== Title ==
<span lang="ja">誰がみすぼらしいって？</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：「みすぼらしいナーフ飼い」、「ウーキーとキスする方がましだわ」、「毛むくじゃら、おかんむり」、「こんなはずじゃあ…」、「死の烙印」、「悲しみの雄叫び」、「タキール」、「ケット・マリス」のいずれかをキャンセルする。2：このターンの終わりまでレネックの戦闘力を2倍にする。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「照れてるのさ。図星をつかれて怒ったんだ。だろ？」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Who's Scruffy-Looking?.

'''Lore''' — "She's just embarrassed. I hit the mark, so she got angry. Right?"

'''Game text''' — Choose one. 1: Cancel Scruffy-Looking Nerf Herder, I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee, Furry Fury, This Is Just Wrong, Death Mark, Mournful Roar, Takeel, or Ket Maliss. 2: Double Rennek's power until this turn ends.

Numbered 1/2 instead of OR. Japanese names the eight cancel targets, including 死の烙印 and 悲しみの雄叫び. Lore is a short paraphrase of Han's line.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-whosscruffylooking.gif|Original English face]], [[Who's Scruffy-Looking?]].</ref>
